1a.text: Night shift, Matt. Phones are quiet tonight. Log everything. Everything.

1b.text: Hello? Is this the help line? I am home alone. Mom said not to open the door.

1c.text: Okay, buddy. Stay calm. What is your name?

1d.text: Somebody is walking in the hallway. Slow. Can you hear it?

1e.text: I cannot hear anything. Where are you calling from?

1f.text: It stopped. It is outside my door. Wait... why can you hear it too?

1h.text: Matt? Why is line three still lit? Nobody is on line three.

2a.text: Matt? It is me. Please do not hang up.

2b.text: Lis? That is not possible. You cannot be...

2c.text: You always hang up. You always do.

2d.text: Do not trust the voice on the radio.

2e.text: I died two years ago, Matt. You were there. You remember, do you not?

2g.text: Is this the help line? I am home alone.

2h.text: Matt, that call is not in the system.

3a.text: Pull the recordings from last night. Check call seventeen.

3b.text: Thank you for calling. This is Matt. Tell me where you are.

3c.text: I am already inside. I am standing behind you.

3d.text: Recording date: November thirteenth. Duration: four minutes.

3e.text: That is tomorrow. That is tomorrow's date.

3f.text: You should have hung up the phone.

4a.text: Power is gone. Generators are down. Stay in your chair. Whatever happens, do not open that door.

4b.text: Matt, open the door. It is cold out here. It is me. It is Lis.

4c.text: Lis is dead. Do you hear me? Do not open it.

4d.text: He is lying. He is not your boss. He has never been your boss.

4e.text: Matt... there is no one in the building. There never was.

5c.text: Every night. For two years. You dial. You listen. You hang up.

5d.text: You never worked here. This is the room where you waited for somebody to answer.

5e.text: Pick a line, Matt. Answer, or let it ring.

5f.text: Hang up. Or tell yourself the truth.

5h.text: Matt, it is you. Do not go to work tonight. Do not take the night shift.

5i.text: The door is opening. It is opening from the inside.
